verdicts.reason: The two candidates are nearly identical shrinks of the leaderboard. In both, the 'New botanical sparkling, out now.' subline and the 'NEW' pill text are tiny (about 6–7 px), and the can icon's label can't be read. A's 'Try It' button is a larger, rounded pill with readable text, close to the original. In B, the CTA has become a smaller, squarer box with cramped, tiny 'Try It' text, which weakens the call to action and loses the pill shape of the brand's button.
